recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，大片淡粉紅、偏纖維化的細胞浸潤取代正常結構，只殘留少數深藍色淋巴濾泡，並可見淡染的結節狀區域，符合系統性肥大細胞症侵犯淋巴結；單顆肥大細胞在此倍率無法辨識。
features: Extensive effacement of lymph node architecture by a pale eosinophilic, fibrotic-appearing infiltrate
Only a few small residual lymphoid follicles (dark blue aggregates) remain
Vague pale nodules and sclerotic, perivascular-appearing zones within the infiltrate
Residual denser lymphoid tissue at the upper right edge
Individual mast cell cytology not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows extensive replacement of the nodal parenchyma by a pale, eosinophilic infiltrate with associated fibrosis and vague nodular pale areas. Only scattered small residual lymphoid follicles remain. Cellular detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In context, findings are consistent with lymph node involvement by systemic mastocytosis; confirmation requires higher power and immunohistochemistry for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: NSCHL shows fibrous bands with Reed-Sternberg/lacunar cells that are CD30+/CD15+, not tryptase+/CD117+ spindle mast cells.
LCH involves sinuses with grooved Langerhans cells and eosinophils that are CD1a+/langerin+.

ddx.dx: Kimura disease or other eosinophil-rich reactive lymphadenopathy
ddx.vs: Reactive processes preserve follicles with eosinophilic microabscesses and lack aggregates of CD25+ mast cells.
